record.question: The Constitution of India, that was adopted on 26th November, 1949 originally had:
record.explanation: Answer A: 22 parts, 395 articles and 8 schedules. At adoption, the Constitution contained 22 Parts, 395 Articles and 8 Schedules; this option states the complete set. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
